title: vb6-archaeology kit configuration
description: Protected source trees, output directories and analysis hints. Validate with `python -m tools config-check`.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, for editor validation.

protected_source_dirs.description: Directory names holding immutable VB6 originals. Hooks deny writes into them.

default_source_dir.description: Directory searched first when a tool needs the originals.

extracts_dir.description: Where extract writes analysis copies (default working/extracts).

skeletons_dir.description: Where form skeleton JSON is written (consumers may point this at a web lib dir).

encoding.description: Primary VB6 source encoding (cp932 for Japanese projects).

encoding_fallbacks.description: Encodings tried when the primary decode fails.

reports_http_port.description: Loopback port used by `python -m tools serve`.

geometry_hints.description: FormName -> twips box, used when resolving parent-relative runtime expressions.

deep_read_name_map.description: VB_Name -> output key override for deep-read (empty means lowercase VB_Name).

layout_sub_scores.description: Lowercase Sub name -> open-path score for layout. Keep app-specific openers in the consumer config.

picture1_height_by_sub.description: Consumer-only: lowercase Sub -> Form VB_Name for Picture1.Height attribution.

verify_report_allow_files.description: Consumer-only: basenames verify-names accepts beyond the inventory.

notes.description: Free-form human notes kept next to the settings they explain.
